directAnswer: You can check a domain name's availability by using a domain registrar's search tool or a WHOIS lookup service.
summary: This guide provides steps to check if a domain name is available for registration and additional information about the domain.

sections.heading: What is a Domain Check?
sections.body: A domain check is the process of verifying whether a specific domain name is available for registration or already in use.

sections.heading: Using Domain Registrars
sections.body: Most domain registrars offer a search feature on their websites that allows you to check domain name availability.

sections.heading: Using WHOIS Lookup
sections.body: WHOIS lookup services provide detailed information about registered domain names, including ownership and registration details.

steps.title: Visit a Domain Registrar
steps.detail: Go to a domain registrar's website such as GoDaddy, Namecheap, or Google Domains.

steps.title: Search for the Domain Name
steps.detail: Enter the desired domain name in the search bar and click the search button.

steps.title: Review Availability
steps.detail: Check the results to see if the domain is available or if it is already registered.

steps.title: Use WHOIS Lookup
steps.detail: If the domain is taken, use a WHOIS lookup service to find out more about the current owner.

faqs.question: What is a WHOIS lookup?
faqs.answer: WHOIS lookup is a query and response protocol used to obtain information about the registration of a domain name.

faqs.question: Can I register a domain name that is currently taken?
faqs.answer: No, you cannot register a domain name that is already taken, but you may be able to purchase it from the current owner.

faqs.question: Are there any restrictions on domain name registration?
faqs.answer: Yes, some domain extensions have specific requirements, such as geographic or organizational restrictions.

caveats: Domain availability can change rapidly, so results may vary from one search to another.
Some registrars may charge different prices for the same domain name.
